about: M3 proof timeline. Ticks are 60 Hz. Camera approximates V3's fight camera (data/fight.json: eye about 2.8 m up, 1.0 m over the shoulder, looking at the foe); distance pulled in so the figure fills the 375-wide frame.

events.note: hit: stagger dip (hold 0.5 s, back over 0.35 s)
final blow: death ramp 1 to 0.01 over 1 s
